pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Shapes are predominantly quadrilateral and pentagonal with rounded vertices. Patch size is largest on the mid-flank and reduces in area towards the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored negative space forming a complete grid. Junction nodes are clearly defined where three or more pathways meet. Corridor thickness is variable, appearing wider on the lower hindquarters than on the upper neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine, vertical bristle-like texture along the dorsal ridge from the upper neck to the shoulder. Silhouette shows high-frequency, low-amplitude serration against the sky background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, localized area of red pigmentation and textural disruption is visible on the upper posterior dorsal ridge near the base of the tail.
other_distinctive_markers: Two dark-plumaged birds with yellow/orange bills are positioned on the hide: one on the upper shoulder/neck junction and one on the lateral mid-flank.
